question: Does the speech-to-speech API support streaming responses?
ground_truth: Yes, use the POST /v1/speech-to-speech/{voice_id}/stream endpoint for real-time streaming voice conversion. This endpoint returns audio as text/event-stream (binary streaming data) instead of waiting for the complete file. You can control latency with optimize_streaming_latency (0-4, where 4 is maximum optimization with text normalizer disabled). The endpoint accepts the same multipart/form-data parameters as the regular voice changer: audio file, model_id, voice_settings, seed, remove_background_noise, and file_format.
